ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous high-intensity region covering ~80% of its area, bounded by a low-intensity margin at the trailing edge and tip. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with sparse high-intensity linear streaks and punctate spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:4 within the central region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; significant pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) observed, particularly on the outer third of both lobes where peaks and valleys exceed 15-pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex anterior sweep tapering to sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips; the trailing edge follows a broadly concave arc from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected on the dark right lobe; isolated dark mottling clusters present within the high-intensity field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple prominent, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing diagonally on the right lobe; shorter vertical dark linear marks are visible on the inner-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the right lobe; irregular, eroded topography of the trailing edge suggests historical tissue loss or significant wear.
other_distinctive_markers: High degree of pigmentation asymmetry between the two lobes, with the left lobe being predominantly white and the right lobe predominantly black.
